en.title: UDI Shipping Assistance System
en.summary: Operational scanning workflow that imports shipment plans, validates GS1 UDI, flags exceptions, and exports auditable completion records.
en.challenge: Daily shipping teams needed a safer way to import shipment plans, scan medical-product UDI codes, catch over-scans or mismatches, and produce an auditable end-of-day result.
contribution: Modeled the shipment workflow from plan import through order selection, scan validation, review, submission, and final export.
Built GS1 Element String, HRI, and Digital Link parsing with internal-product mapping and explicit exception states.
Added SQLite persistence, Excel export, database backup, runtime configuration, feature tiers, license handling, Docker packaging, and integration tests.
technical: FastAPI exposes a versioned operational API and serves a focused single-page scanning interface.
Browser session state keeps in-progress scans temporary; only confirmed orders are committed to SQLite.
Service modules separate plan import, UDI mapping, validation, submission, reporting, and launcher behavior.

architecture.label: Input
architecture.detail: CSV/XLSX shipment plan and scanned GS1 UDI strings enter the operator workspace.

architecture.label: Validation
architecture.detail: UDI parser and mapping data resolve GTIN/UDI-DI, part number, item, and expected quantity.

architecture.label: Workflow API
architecture.detail: FastAPI services manage previews, exception states, submissions, statistics, and session reset.

architecture.label: Records
architecture.detail: Confirmed results persist to SQLite; Excel summaries and a database backup are exported at close.

outcomes: Turns scan exceptions into explicit operator decisions instead of silent shipping errors.
Provides auditable order history, daily statistics, Excel settlement, and backup artifacts.
Includes route-level unit and real HTTP integration coverage for the operational API.

zh.title: UDI 出貨輔助系統
zh.summary: 匯入出貨計畫、驗證 GS1 UDI、標示例外，並輸出可稽核完成紀錄的作業系統。
zh.role: 解決方案架構師與全端工程師
zh.challenge: 每日出貨團隊需要更安全的方式匯入出貨計畫、掃描醫療產品 UDI、攔截超量掃描或不符項目，並產生可稽核的日終結果。
contribution: 建立從計畫匯入、訂單選擇、掃描驗證、覆核、送出到最終匯出的完整出貨流程模型。
建置 GS1 Element String、HRI 與 Digital Link 解析，整合內部產品對應及明確例外狀態。
加入 SQLite 持久化、Excel 匯出、資料庫備份、執行設定、功能分級、授權處理、Docker 封裝與整合測試。
technical: FastAPI 提供版本化作業 API，並服務專注於掃描工作的單頁介面。
瀏覽器工作階段狀態暫存進行中的掃描，只有確認後的訂單才寫入 SQLite。
服務模組分離計畫匯入、UDI 對應、驗證、送出、報告與啟動器行為。

architecture.label: 輸入
architecture.detail: CSV／XLSX 出貨計畫與掃描的 GS1 UDI 字串進入操作員工作區。

architecture.label: 驗證
architecture.detail: UDI 解析器與對應資料解析 GTIN／UDI-DI、料號、品項與預期數量。

architecture.label: 工作流程 API
architecture.detail: FastAPI 服務管理預覽、例外狀態、送出、統計與工作階段重設。

architecture.label: 紀錄
architecture.detail: 確認結果保存至 SQLite；結束作業時匯出 Excel 摘要與資料庫備份。

outcomes: 將掃描例外轉換為明確的操作員決策，避免成為未被發現的出貨錯誤。
提供可稽核訂單歷程、每日統計、Excel 結算與備份檔案。
作業 API 具備路由層單元測試與真實 HTTP 整合測試。
